newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 recoups losses, ends flat on Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 recoups losses, ends flat on Dow rise.

text.p: UK's FTSE 100 ended nearly unchanged on Monday, as a strong start on Wall Street helped lift UK shares from an initial deficit, dealers said.
The leading share index closed 2.1 points lower at 4,810.7, as decliners narrowly beat advancers 52 to 46.
A successful market deubt by Woolwich Plc in ever buoyant bank stocks led the sector higher amid renewed talk of consolidation in the banking counter.
Yet dealers said the market faces an uphill stuggle during the next few days ahead of the Bank of England policy meeting on Thursday.
